paradigm_today.classification: mixed: functional-core+imperative-shell (reducer/store) over event-driven transport over layered macro-structure
layers: transport adapter: src/marmot/network.ts (NdkNetworkAdapter implements marmot-ts NostrNetworkInterface)
MLS ingest: src/marmot/device-sync.ts (useDeviceSync hook; group.ingest, ingestLock, retry)
domain normalization: src/store/task-reducer.ts applyEvent via applicationMessage
paradigm_today.correctness_fragmentation: CRDT convergence rules live in task-reducer.ts (pure); MLS epoch ordering/ingest serialization/retry live in useDeviceSync closure (imperative, effect-bound); optimistic apply + publish ordering live in task-store.tsx dispatch (React, async)

two_listeners_confirmed.persistence_listener: device-sync.ts:874-892 attachAppMsgListener -> appendEvent(group.idStr, taskEvent), fire-and-forget; survives TaskStoreProvider unmount (lives in useDeviceSync)
two_listeners_confirmed.react_listener: task-store.tsx:181-255 handleApplicationMessage -> applyEvent(stateRef.current, taskEvent) + setState; lost on unmount
two_listeners_confirmed.coordination: none; both fire for every incoming application message, each independently calls deserializeApplicationData; delivery order guaranteed only by EventEmitter, no explicit sequencing

persistence_reality.mechanism: IndexedDB via idb-keyval through createKVStore<T> (storage.ts:100-133); per-pubkey DB namespacing notestr-${pubkey}-${name}
persistence_reality.appendEvent: persistence.ts:29-36 read-modify-write (loadEvents -> push -> setItem); NO idempotency key, NOT atomic, NOT transactional
persistence_reality.race: device-sync persistence listener (remote) and task-store dispatch (local) can both call appendEvent; concurrent callers on same key can lose writes (last-write-wins on the array)
persistence_reality.log_inflation: duplicates accumulate silently; reducer idempotence (property C3) keeps FINAL STATE safe but log grows unbounded and replayEvents folds every entry
relevant_stores: group-sync (key groupId -> string[] seen kind-445 event ids; storage.ts:391-406)
group-state (SerializedClientState; managed by marmot-ts) -- the persisted MLS state P2 requires

existing_building_blocks.pure_reducer: task-reducer.ts:5-105 applyEvent (LWW CRDT, three-level tie-break updatedAt->updatedBy->updatedByDevice; task.created is FWW) + replayEvents (log-fold). Pure, no React. MATURE; used by publishTaskStateSync and bootstrap.
existing_building_blocks.ingest_queue: ingest-queue.ts createPendingRetryQueue: pure, framework-agnostic, bounded(200), TTL(24h), O(1) id-dedupe, FIFO eviction. = the spec's 'Deferred Event' concept. MATURE, unit-tested.
existing_building_blocks.ingestLock: device-sync.ts:651 Map<string,Promise> chain-promise mutex per group; serializes group.ingest to avoid ts-mls state races. Closure-private to the hook.
existing_building_blocks.retry_on_epoch: device-sync.ts:819-870 attachRetryOnEpochAdvance on group.on('stateChanged'); triggers on newEpoch>prev; MAX_RETRIES_PER_EPOCH=3; lastEpoch Map<string,bigint>.
existing_building_blocks.drain_on_ingest: device-sync.ts:759-793 Solution B: drains retry queue when >=1 event processed; selectAndIncrementRetries pure+tested.
existing_building_blocks.subscribe_first_cutover: device-sync.ts:925-1010 syncGroup: liveBuffer, cutoverComplete flag, t0-60s overlap since-bridge; historical fetch during buffer accumulation; sort by created_at + drain through ingest lock on cutover.
existing_building_blocks.outbox_bridge_partial: device-sync.ts:86-290 enqueueExpectedPublish/consumeExpectedPublishForKind445/begin|endDispatchPublishWindow: per-hTag FIFO correlating rumor.id->kind445 eventId at publish to work around marmot-ts own-echo suppression. Handles TRACEABILITY only, not durability/retry.
existing_building_blocks.trace: mls-trace.ts: MlsTrace + TraceEvent union (16 variants) covering full receive+dispatch path; build-gated (NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TRACE_MLS). Close to 'engine metadata' vocabulary.

framework_coupling_to_remove: useDeviceSync IS a React hook (device-sync.ts:487); whole receive state machine lives in a useEffect closure; all internal state resets on unmount
mountedRef.current guards (device-sync.ts:508,896,986,1000) silently stop receive on unmount
TaskStoreProvider second applicationMessage listener calls setState directly from protocol callback (F3 race class)
load + listener-attach useEffects; message between mount and attach is lost (F3a); stale-load overwrite race (F3d) task-store.tsx:154-166
client.tsx attachStateListener calls React setState from group.on('stateChanged')
ADR-001 sender-side monotonic bump ensureMonotonicTimestamp lives in dispatch() in React layer (task-store.tsx); must move with publish/outbox layer

marmot_surface.ingest: group.ingest(events)->async iterable of IngestResult {kind: processed|skipped|rejected|unreadable, event}; marmot-ts owns epoch-advance + MLS state mutation
marmot_surface.events: group.on('applicationMessage', (data:Uint8Array)) on decrypt of kind-31337 rumor; NOT fired for own-echo. group.on('stateChanged') on epoch OR ratchet advance (disambiguate via lastEpoch).
marmot_surface.own_echo: marmot-ts suppresses self-echo at ingest (skipped/self-echo); reason outbox bridge operates on publish path not receive path
marmot_surface.no_catchup_api: historical vs live is entirely consumer-managed in syncGroup; no marmot-ts catch-up abstraction
marmot_surface.fork: marmot-ts is a controlled fork consumed as a packed tarball (see CLAUDE.md)

ordering_identity.adr_001: docs/adr/ADR-001: updatedAt(seconds) primary, updatedBy(pubkey lower-wins), updatedByDevice(MLS clientId lower-wins). Rejected ms-timestamps and Lamport. Sender-side monotonic bump added.
ordering_identity.alignment: new epic spec.md:495 'timestamps must not be sole correctness boundary' ALIGNS with ADR-001 (already three-level). Lamport named as next axis if needed.
ordering_identity.gap: NO stable idempotency key on TaskEvent today. Dedupe is on kind-445 event IDs (MLS layer), not TaskEvent identity. rumor.id is the correlator but is NOT a field on TaskEvent. spec.md:492 'every accepted domain event must have a stable idempotency key' is UNSATISFIED.
